anomalies.expected: For a high-side P-MOSFET switched by an NPN driver, the gate needs a DC pull-up to source/VCC (typically a resistor, e.g. 10 kΩ) so that when Q2 turns off the gate returns to source voltage and Q1 turns off. A capacitor alone cannot provide this bias.
anomalies.impact: After Q2 pulls the P-MOSFET gate low, C3 can hold the gate low when Q2 turns off, leaving Q1 on or making the fan PWM switching undefined. The fan may stay on or fail to respond correctly to control.
